supporting_quotes.exact: The API models the camera subsystem as a pipeline that converts incoming requests for frame captures into frames, on a 1:1 basis.

observations.subject: Camera HAL3 API
observations.object: camera subsystem pipeline that converts incoming frame-capture requests into frames on a 1:1 basis

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-fe448cb00526[0,129] 直接陈述 "The API models the camera subsystem as a pipeline that converts incoming requests for frame captures into frames, on a 1:1 basis"，与 claim 的建模为流水线、capture request 按 1:1 转换为 frame 逐项吻合（含 1:1 表述），无相反证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL. Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL).

observations.subject: Camera HAL interface
observations.object: Android 13 -> AIDL; Android 8.0 -> Treble/HIDL stable interface

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-cf017f340ff1[0,209] 同时给出两个时点：Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL 与 Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL)，与 claim 的 Android 13 起 AIDL、Android 8.0 Treble/HIDL 稳定接口完全一致，无相反证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: The HAL sits between the camera driver and the higher-level Android framework and defines an interface that you must implement so apps can correctly operate the camera hardware.
Android's camera hardware abstraction layer (HAL) connects the higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to your underlying camera driver and hardware.

observations.subject: Camera HAL
observations.object: camera driver and higher-level Android framework; defines implementable interface for app camera operation

observations.subject: Camera HAL
observations.object: Camera 2 framework APIs with underlying camera driver and hardware

claims.rationale: evidence-d937f440c251[0,176] 说明 HAL 位于 camera driver 与更高层 Android framework 之间并定义应用正确操作相机所需实现的接口；evidence-8a33cfacf842[0,155] 说明 HAL 将 Camera 2 框架 API 连接到底层 camera driver 与硬件。两引文分别覆盖 claim 的向上连接 Camera 2 框架 API 与向下定义接口，相互一致、共同支持 claim，无相反证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: Android 9 introduced API support for multi-camera devices through a new logical camera device composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction. The logical camera device is exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app allowing for interaction with HAL-integrated multi-camera features.

observations.subject: logical camera device
observations.object: composed of two or more same-direction physical cameras, exposed to apps as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-260cce4b839f[0,327] 完整承载 claim 全部要素：Android 9 引入多摄像头 API 支持（Android 9 introduced API support for multi-camera devices）、逻辑设备由两个或多个同向物理摄像头组成（composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction）、对应用呈现为单个 CameraDevice/CaptureSession（is exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app），无相反证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: Most of this information is a static property of the camera subsystem and can therefore be queried before configuring any output pipelines or submitting any requests.

the new camera API adds a substantial amount of dynamic metadata to each captured frame. This includes the requested and actual parameters used for the capture, as well as additional per-frame metadata such as timestamps and statistics generator output.
For most settings, the expectation is that they can be changed every frame, without introducing significant stutter or delay to the output frame stream.

observations.subject: static metadata
observations.object: static property of the camera subsystem, queryable before configuring output pipelines or submitting requests

observations.subject: dynamic metadata
observations.object: requested/actual parameters, timestamps, statistics generator output

observations.subject: control settings
observations.object: every frame without significant stutter or delay to output frame stream

claims.rationale: 三条引文与 claim 的三类描述一一对应：evidence-ec5493ad2bf0[0,165] 支持 static（static property of the camera subsystem、queried before configuring any output pipelines or submitting any requests）；evidence-ccd5ac3651b7[0,253] 支持 dynamic（adds a substantial amount of dynamic metadata to each captured frame，含 requested/actual parameters、timestamps、statistics）；evidence-5fc4b7551293[0,151] 支持 control（changed every frame, without introducing significant stutter or delay）。分三类框架为三引文的一一归纳，各引文内容相互补充、无冲突。

supporting_quotes.exact: A hardware abstraction layer (HAL) is type of abstraction layer with a standard interface for hardware vendors to implement. A HAL allows hardware vendors to implement lower-level, device-specific features without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers.
HIDL enables communication between HAL clients and HAL services.

observations.subject: HAL
observations.object: abstraction layer with standard interface for vendors; enables device-specific lower-level features without affecting higher-level code

observations.subject: HIDL
observations.object: communication between HAL clients and HAL services

claims.rationale: evidence-d8e44be806f4[0,265] 定义 HAL 为给硬件厂商实现的标准接口抽象层（standard interface for hardware vendors to implement），允许厂商实现底层设备特定功能而不影响更高层代码（without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers）；evidence-ffb3b59c768e[0,64] 明确 HIDL 用于 HAL client 与 HAL service 之间通信。两引文共同、无冲突地支持 claim。

supporting_quotes.exact: Most tests in VTS are GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation.

observations.subject: VTS tests
observations.object: GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation

claims.rationale: 引文 evidence-21f66837f09c[0,73] 直接陈述 Most tests in VTS are GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation，与 claim 的 VTS 中大多数测试是检查 HAL 实现的 GTest 风格测试逐字对应，无相反证据。

supporting_quotes.exact: hardware devices are modelled as an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads.

An entity is a basic media hardware building block. It can correspond to a large variety of logical blocks such as physical hardware devices (CMOS sensor for instance), logical hardware devices (a building block in a System-on-Chip image processing pipeline), DMA channels or physical connectors.

observations.subject: hardware devices
observations.object: oriented graph of entities connected through pads (media controller model)

observations.subject: Entity
observations.object: basic media hardware building block, e.g. CMOS sensor, SoC image processing pipeline block, DMA channels, physical connectors

claims.rationale: evidence-d3551866bc58[0,109] 说明硬件设备被建模为通过 pad 连接的 entity 有向图（modelled as an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads），与 claim 的 entity 图（media controller）一致；evidence-0267a563245f[0,297] 说明 entity 为基本媒体硬件构建块（basic media hardware building block），可对应 CMOS sensor、SoC 图像处理流水线、DMA 通道等（CMOS sensor for instance、System-on-Chip image processing pipeline、DMA channels）。两引文相互一致、共同支持 claim，无相反证据。
